purpose: Update the Dev exposure boundary after the final two previously unexecuted identities entered prospective development experiments.

research_decision.dev_role: All 205 identities are consumed development data. Dev may support taxonomy formation, mechanism diagnosis, and targeted replication, but not repository-unseen generalization.
research_decision.unseen_role: Repository-unseen effect estimation must use the protected Canary and Official Test splits after the method and analysis are fixed.
research_decision.bad_case_role: A treatment-unrun historical failure stratum may test repair behavior only when its complete selection rule is recorded before current treatment execution.

limitations: Exposure means at least one method executed on the identity; it does not imply uniform baseline coverage or a completed causal annotation.
